summary: Helport AI Limited filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $9,550,000 of ordinary shares through Lake Street Capital Markets as sales agent. No fixed price, premium, or board recommendation is stated; shares will be sold at prevailing market prices on Nasdaq under symbol HPAI. The closing price on July 9, 2026, was $0.65 per share. Lake Street receives up to 3.0% commission with no escrow arrangement. An ATM program is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. No risk-arb angle applies.
